## Source
.design/m5/47-trust-model.md — Open Questions Q1-Q6.

## Decisions required (provisional in #133)
- Q1 expression form: A (structured only) vs B (mini-DSL) vs C (JSON Logic / Rego). Provisional A.
- Q2 decay model: A (exponential half-life) vs B (linear) vs C (step). Provisional A.
- Q3 audit UX: which combination of admin filter (A), CSV report (B), per-observation case-view visibility (C). Provisional C + A.
- Q4 v1→v2 deser: A (untagged enum) vs B (versioned discriminator + migration) vs C (lazy migration on write). Provisional B.
- Q5 default policy: A (v1 flat unchanged) vs B (v1 flat + default decay) vs C (neutral 0.5). Provisional A.
- Q6 boost-attack mitigations: A (save-time cap) + B (eval-time clamp) baseline; C (aggregate-change alert) + D (senior co-sign) as follow-ups.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Six decisions recorded as `--kind decision` comments.

## Blocks
- Blocks #144 (Q1 + Q4 shape the data model PR 1 establishes).
